notes: Binary paths refer to the local evidence workspace; SHA-256 identifies each measured build.
bulk_large isolates bulk moves against an earlier correctness-fixed candidate; both predate the large-graph retry correction, which only affects counts above 255.
final_common compares the original revision using the same harness against the final candidate.
Performance timings apply to these workloads and host conditions, not all messages.
Raw stdout and full reports remain in /tmp/protocache-release; this archive retains each measured sample and checksum.
